description: This PHP source file defines the NotEqualsOperator class within the SuiteCRM project. It implements a filter operator used to represent 'not equal to' comparisons in JSON API filters, providing methods to output corresponding filter tags and SQL operators, and validates operator inputs.

classes.name: NotEqualsOperator
classes.description: A class representing the 'not equals' filter operator in SuiteCRM's JSON API filters. It provides methods for obtaining filter and SQL representations and for validating operator input.

methods.name: toFilterOperator
methods.description: Returns the filter-specific string representation of the 'not equals' operator, specifically 'ne'.

methods.name: toSqlOperator
methods.description: Returns the SQL representation of the 'not equals' operator, which is '!='.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Validates that the provided operator is a string and checks its validity via the parent class's isValid method. Throws an exception if the input is not a string.
